title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：steel　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 steel 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the observer ① made the steel that no assistant in the observatory would have described, and he said the making was the whole of the night. The ② steel, meaning the metal itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; steel, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sort of steel in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ steel at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Steel, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the observer said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the steel was the whole of the matter, meaning the strength and not the metal. The ⑥ steel, meaning the strength and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; steel, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both metal and a strength. He said the strength is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ steel had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ steel of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of describing; steel, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ steel I remember is the steel described in the log, which closed in 1982 and is still described as the quietest in the observatory. ⑩ Steel, my mother said in 1984, is the only thing that improves by being described; all steel, she said, is a strength that has agreed to look like metal. She said the strength was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 钢（指观测站里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 钢（指那块钢本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the steel 炼这一块钢
D. n. 钢（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 钢之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的钢之事）
F. n. 钢（指观测记录里写到、被描述的那一块）
G. n. 钢、刚强（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 刚强（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the steel that no assistant in the observatory would have described
The steel, meaning the metal itself and not the lens
Every sort of steel in that observatory
the steel at the far dome
the steel was the whole of the matter
the steel had become a line in a log
The steel of the whole thing

answers.why: make the steel 意为“炼这一块钢”，1975 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯描述的一块钢做了一遍。
steel 意为“钢”，指那块钢本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
steel 意为“钢”，指观测站里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
steel 意为“钢”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
steel 意为“钢、刚强”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块刚强就是那件事的全部。
steel 意为“刚强”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块钢，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
steel 意为“钢”，指观测记录里写到、被描述的那一块，到 1980 年这一块成了观测记录里的一行。
steel 意为“钢之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的钢之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的描述。
steel 意为“钢”，我记得的是观测记录里描述过的那一块，1982 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一块。
steel 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，钢是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的钢。
